name: Natsugami Haruna
source:
A girl in the same class as [url=/c95191]Souma[/url].

She approached and befriended [url=/c95193]Shiina[/url] and [url=/c95194]Kuzuhara[/url] of her own accord despite their reputation as problem children even in the school.

Much of what she says is lies. It appears that she keeps many secrets that she doesn't want others to know about.

[Translated from [url=https://ci-en.dlsite.com/creator/220/article/418175]Ci-en[/url]]
